justification: A depicts a narrative processional scene in shallow relief — a horse in strict profile drawing a spoked-wheel chariot with a driver, above a border band of repeated rosettes — while B is a three-dimensional blocky standing figure with a massive head, incised arms/hands converging on the belly, and a few schematic discs and hanging elements on the torso. The only overlap is the generic presence of a human form and circular motifs; there is no shared scene, relationship, arrangement, or carving convention (profile narrative relief versus frontal monolithic body-shaped figure).
